register.labelZh: FLING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fling on 和 fling off 可表示在時間緊迫時,迅速穿上或脫掉衣物。；fling yourself into something 表示某人充滿熱情和幹勁地投入一項活動。；fling yourself into something 表示熱情投入活動;fling yourself at somebody 則表示以過分露骨的方式向某人示愛。；這組 FLING 片語動詞常帶有突然、迅速和有力的感覺,有助理解對話和故事。
register.summaryEn: Fling on and fling off describe putting on or removing clothes very quickly, especially when there is little time. Fling yourself into something shows that a person begins an activity with great energy and enthusiasm. Fling yourself into something describes enthusiastic effort, while fling yourself at somebody describes overly obvious romantic interest. FLING expressions often carry a sudden, energetic feeling, which is useful when understanding conversations and stories.
